title.en: Our school: a green and caring place

text.en: Aasha, Mohit and their classmates form School Explorer Teams to look at their school with new eyes.

A green school is clean, safe and caring for students, teachers and the environment.
Swachh Bharat Swachh Vidyalaya, part of the Swachh Bharat Mission, keeps schools clean and healthy with clean toilets, safe drinking water, proper waste management and hygiene education. Every child has the right to study in a clean and safe place.
Walk around your school and draw its map: the main building, playground, garden, water tanks, gate and paths.
Think: what do I like about my school, how can I make it greener, and whom do I tell if there is a difficulty?
School Explorer teams can be Water Watchers, Electricity Savers, Waste Warriors, Green Guardians and Traffic Trackers. Each team decides what to observe.
Green Guardians look at trees, plants, birds and butterflies. Water Watchers look for leaking taps and uncovered tanks. Electricity Savers check lights and fans left on.
Mawlynnong in Meghalaya is celebrated as Asia's cleanest village.
